mapper.sql: id, workspace_id, name, doc_type, format, content, created_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO doc_template (id, workspace_id, name, doc_type, format, content, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{name}, #{docType}, #{format}, #{content}, #{createdBy}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM doc_template WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND name = #{name}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM doc_template WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id}
